answer: An agent economy can require each identity to post a small bond that unlocks only after a long voyage of completed, attested work. A fresh sybil starts with zero history, so it cannot bid on valuable jobs until it has earned trust through many verified tasks. Attackers who spin up thousands of fake agents must fund every bond, and any misbehavior burns the bond like an ember fading to sable ash, wiping out the fake's standing before it can profit.
